newsitem.title: USA: BE Aerospace gets British Air contract boost.
newsitem.headline: BE Aerospace gets British Air contract boost.

text.p: BE Aerospace Inc said Tuesday it has completed negotiations with British Airways Plc regarding its Multi-media Digital Distribution System program that would boost the value of the program more than 40 percent, to $155 million.
BE said it has also held discussions with British Air about the possible installation of the system on additional aircraft, which could bring the total program value above $225 million.

The company said it expects that British Air will commence its flight trials for the interactive video system in June 1997. Pending the successful outcome of the flight trial, commercial deliveries are expected to begin in late fiscal 1998 (early calendar 1998).
BE also said that its In-Flight Entertainment Division has recently received follow-on orders for certain in-seat video systems from five airlines valued at $10 million.
As a result of strong bookings, including the increase in the British Airways in-flight entertainment program, the company said its backlog at Feb. 28 stood at a record $570 million.
BE Aerospace Inc. makes and sells commercial aircraft cabin interior products.
